sentence: This project brings together basic, clinical and population science research to prevent, diagnose and treat cancers including breast, prostate, lung, colorectal, melanoma and lymphoma.
This project builds heart magnetic resonance imaging on an ultra-low field magnet and uses artificial intelligence to improve image quality.
This project builds mass spectrometry tools to study whole proteoforms and their complexes and find the changes behind human diseases.
This project studies how mitochondrial function and genetic variation affect immune and cognitive problems in people with HIV.
This project tries to find out what controls gut permeability to food allergens, which drives oral anaphylaxis.
This project gives biostatistics, bioinformatics and data management support so studies are designed well and results are analyzed properly.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that control immune cell production during infection, using mouse models.
This project tests a shared care model that helps oncologists and primary care providers work together for cancer patients with chronic conditions.
This project studies whether hematopoietic stem cell dysfunction explains why treatments fail in patients with refractory Crohn's disease.
This project builds a test that finds early β cell death in Type 1 Diabetes using methylation patterns in cell-free DNA.
This project tests how well immune responses to a blood-stage malaria vaccine candidate work against different human Plasmodium species.
This project tests whether the spine apparatus and the axon cisternal organelle keep synapses stable and strong as the brain develops.
This project studies how natural killer cells help control diseases caused by the human polyomavirus BK.
This project studies how reactive chemicals in indoor air change house dust mite so it triggers allergic inflammation.
This project studies how an innate immune sensor recognizes oxidized mitochondrial DNA to start inflammation, using structural and biochemical approaches.
This project builds community partnerships to study and prevent neuroHIV complications in people with HIV who are not engaged in care.
This project creates statistical methods and software that use genetic scores and multi-omics data to understand the causes of human diseases.
This project develops single-domain antibodies that target the hepatitis B virus surface antigen as a treatment for chronic infection.
This project builds a biosensor that lets transplant patients screen for the virus at home and a protein switch that kills virally infected cells.
This project studies the cells and molecules behind neurovascular coupling in the visual system, which is impaired in neurodegenerative diseases.
